plate.what: a full suit of plate armour

parts.waist: steel faulds and a leather belt
parts.shoulders: rounded steel pauldrons and a gorget
parts.knees: round steel knee cops centred on the white area

plate.look: Dark slate steel with brass rivets and trim, brown leather straps and buckles, soft painted stylized fantasy look, smooth shading

archmage.what: the robes of a powerful archmage of an age touched by time

parts.chest: a fitted robe front with layered ivory and deep midnight-blue silk, gold filigree and a small hourglass sigil
parts.back: the robe's back in midnight blue with a large circular clock-rune emblem in gold
parts.waist: a wide embroidered sash with gold clasps
parts.shoulders: a high ornate mantle of ivory and gold with small turquoise gems
parts.forearms: engraved gold-and-leather bracers with faintly glowing rune lines
parts.hands: fine dark gloves with gold rings
parts.legs: long robe panels falling to the ankle with a richly embroidered hem on the shins, no armour plates
parts.feet: soft midnight-blue boots with gold toe caps

archmage.look: Deep midnight blue, ivory and warm gold, with faint turquoise time-runes and tiny clock-face motifs worked into the embroidery, slightly time-worn edges, elegant and powerful, soft painted stylized fantasy look, smooth shading

parts.chest: a fitted dark green leather jerkin with stitched seams and a laced front
parts.back: the jerkin's back with a quiver strap running diagonally
parts.waist: a wide leather belt with pouches and a brass buckle
parts.shoulders: a short hooded mantle of moss-green wool
parts.arms: brown leather sleeves with a laced archer's bracer on the forearms
parts.legs: fitted brown leather trousers with padded knees and strapped shin wraps

ranger.look: Moss green, warm browns and muted tan, worn handmade leather, soft painted stylized fantasy look, smooth shading
